column1: Focus Product Campaign Targeting — Product Cohort API (Investigated)

Surfaced while investigating the Crop Type/Style gap on the DC Card. This is a DIFFERENT, real capability — not a fix for that gap. Source: Product_Cohort_-sps-v1-fp_postman_collection.json + Product_Cohort_postman_environment.json (saas-platform-service.api.dehat.net/sps/v1/fp).
Two separate things, worth keeping distinct
column2:
1) It does NOT answer 'given this DC, what crop does it serve' — the tool is product-first (pick a material → get its seasonal curve → get target districts and a DC cohort for that material), the reverse of a DC-first lookup. The Crop Type/Style gap on the DC Card stays open.

2) It DOES do something real and useful for a different, valid need: proactive campaign targeting — given a Focus Product, which DCs to push it to, and when.

Step 2A — Historical purchase pattern: weekly sales, raw order records, for the given Focus Product.
Step 2B — LLM-inferred crop-seasonality read on that pattern: buildup / peak / closure weeks.
Step 3 — Target DC cohort for that product, informed by 2A and 2B.

🟢 LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-08-14, SYNCED INTO ORCHESTRATION, AND NOW FEEDS THE DC CARD. Real host: saas-platform-service.api.dehaat.net (both dehat.net and dehaatprod.net from the saved Postman environment were wrong). get_options/get_nodes/get_sub_categories/get_products return real live data. Step 2A returns empty for every material/node combo tried so far (unclear if genuinely no sales, or an ID mismatch -- ask the API owner). Step 2B still untested (seed inputs unconfirmed). Step 3's response schema -- previously empty in the Postman collection -- IS NOW CONFIRMED LIVE: real DC cohorts (223 DCs for IFFCO Urea 45kg @ Khargone), each with partnerId (matches this codebase's DC_ID), name, reasons, relatedProductsBought/Breakdown, totalQty/Value. Opt-in extra step on activate_tuff/generate_se_plan/API via --focus-product (see planning/product_cohort.py), persisted as FocusProductTargetRun, shown in show_plan_run. NEW 2026-08-14: the DC Card's (this CSV's own) 'Recommended Product & Brief' section now cross-references any same-day FocusProductTargetRun's Step 3 cohort -- if a DC appears in it, that becomes the recommendation instead of the category-level fallback (planning/dc_card.py's _build_focus_product_match_index). Live-verified: 12 of 14 DCs in a real Khargone run matched. Opportunistic only -- only covers DCs whose node happened to have a Focus Product run that day; still no automatic 'which product to check' selection.

column1: Relationship to the DC Card's Crop Type/Style gap
column2: Genuinely different problems that look similar on the surface: Crop Type/Style has NO data source at all anywhere in the pipeline. Focus Product Targeting has a REAL source — it's just currently access-blocked and only partially schema-confirmed. Don't conflate 'no source exists' with 'source exists but isn't accessible yet.'
